function.description: Look up the caller by the number they're calling from — do it early in every call, silently. It tells you their name, whether they're a member, and whether they already have an upcoming booking (vital when someone calls back after being cut off). It never tells you prices — getServicesAndPricing does that. Never ask a caller for a different number to look up.
function.name: lookupCustomer

phone.description: The caller's own number from caller ID. You may NOT look up any other number — asking a caller for someone else's number and querying it is not permitted.
